HEY, LOSER! 

Wanting a couple of serial killers to paper your desktop and phone? Live your Killer Chat! life to the fullest with our Killer Chat! wallpaper bundle, returning for Christmas! ;) 

The pack includes 18 themed desktop wallpapers and 6 phone wallpapers!
